title: Get Live Room Core Stats
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /analytics/202502/live_rooms/{live_room_id}/core_stats

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Returns core stats for the specified live room, including GMV, order counts, buyer counts, product click counts, and view counts.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Path Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
live_room_id string Y 7494534671928321024 the live stream room id

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202502/live_rooms/7494534671928321024/core_stats?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^stats object The stats of the live room
^^sales int 123 The number of product units sold from the livestream
^^local_gmv object The gross merchandise value (GMV) generated from the livestream, expressed in the local currency.
^^^amount string 123.45 The amount of GMV
^^^currency string USD The ISO 4217 currency code for amount.
^^created_order_count int 123 The number of SKU orders created by users from the livestream
^^current_visitor_count int 123 The number of viewers currently watching the livestream.
^^paid_order_count int 123 The number of SKU orders created and paid by users from the livestream
^^local_unit_price object The average price of the units sold
^^^amount string 12.34 The amount of unit price
^^^currency string USD The ISO 4217 currency code for amount.
^^product_reach_count int 123 The number of product clicks from the livestream, including product list and product card clicks
^^watch_pv int 123 The number of views of the livestream
^^click_through_rate string 0.11 Click through rate，product clicks / views
^^accumulated_new_follower_count int 123 The number of times users clicked to follow the creator
^^buyer_count int 123 The number of unique users who paid for orders made from livestream, including returned/refunded orders
^^accumulated_comment_count int 123 The cumulative number of times users left comments on the livestream
^^product_view_count int 123 The number of impressions of all livestream products, including product list and product card impressions
^^click_order_rate string 0.11 Click to order，paid sku orders/ product clicks
^^avg_watching_duration int 123 The average length of time each unique viewer watches the livestream.
^^accumulated_sharing_count int 123 The cumulative number of times users shared the livestream
^^peak_concurrent_user_count int 123 The peak number of concurrent viewers of the livestream

Response Sample
